cleavage agent: digested with 0.2 μg/μL trypsin overnight at 37 °C
instrument: Tandem mass spectrometry analyses were performed on a QExactive Orbitrap Plus (Thermo Electron)
labeling: To obtain quantitative information on the protein cargo of MP released during different infection conditions we used the Tandem Mass TagTM (TMT) isobaric labelling technology (ThermoFisher Scientific).
precursor tolerance: the precursor ion tolerance was set to 10 ppm
ptm: carbamidomethylation of cysteines (fixed); oxidation of methionines (variable); TMT0 or the TMT6 modifications on lysines and peptide N-termini (fixed)

carbamidomethylation of cysteines as fixed modification and oxidation of methionines as variable modification; Additionally, the TMT0 or the TMT6 modifications on lysines and peptide N-termini were added as fixed modifications in the respective experiments.
